tasks.title: Portfolio brief tool + staleness detection over MCP
tasks.description: Epic E-09, the surface a Claude session actually calls. Add an MCP tool (packages/lane-mcp, alongside the existing note tools) named portfolio_brief that returns, for a requested period and optional project filter, the collected reports across all registered projects joined per project. STALENESS IS A FIRST-CLASS FINDING, NOT AN ERROR: for every enabled project in the registry, compare the newest collected report against expected_cadence_hours; if none arrived in time, emit an explicit stale entry saying which line is missing and how long it has been silent. This is the single most valuable thing the hub does that no project can do for itself — a project whose collector silently died looks 'fine' to anyone reading its last report, and only the hub knows a report was due and never came. Never omit a registered project from the output just because it has no data; absence must be visible. Also join the lines by commit sha where available so the tool can report chains like 'T-0002 → sha abc123 → deployment failed', and flag any sha that merged but has no successful deployment. Mark each field's provenance so a reading agent never relays a guess as a fact: measured (read from an API), derived (computed from measured data), or asserted (text a project wrote about itself). Return structured JSON, not prose — the calling agent writes the prose. Do NOT pre-filter by importance: send everything for the period and let the calling agent triage, because what matters is often only visible across projects. Auth stays client-scoped like the other MCP tools. Add tests with fixture reports covering: a healthy project, a stale project, and a project whose merge has no successful deploy.

tasks.title: GitHub read tools over MCP: github_get_file, github_list_commits, github_list_pull_requests
tasks.description: Epic E-12. Add three new MCP tools alongside the existing ones in packages/lane-mcp/src/index.ts (same registerOrbitaTools function/pattern used for note_put, trigger_automation from T-0054). All three resolve the SAME existing credential — resolveCredentialSecret(credentialsDb, secretsKey, clientId, 'github_read') — no new credential name needed; github_read already exists (D-002, 2026-08-09) and already covers every repo that credential's token can read, so unlike T-0054 there is no per-repo or per-lane split. 1) github_get_file — input { repo: z.string() (owner/name), path: z.string(), ref: z.string().optional() (branch/tag/sha; default the repo's default branch) }. Fetch via GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}?ref={ref}, base64-decode the content field, return { path, ref, content, sha }. On 404 return isError:true with a clear 'not found' message — do NOT return an empty string, the caller must be able to tell 'file does not exist' apart from 'file is empty'. 2) github_list_commits — input { repo: z.string(), branch: z.string().optional(), limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).optional() (default 10), since: z.string().optional() (ISO date) }. Fetch via GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits?sha={branch}&per_page={limit}&since={since if given}. Return an array of { sha, message (first line only), author, date }. 3) github_list_pull_requests — input { repo: z.string(), state: z.enum(['open','closed','all']).optional() (default 'open') }. Fetch via GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state={state}&per_page=50. Return an array of { number, title, branch (mapped from head.ref), draft, created_at, html_url }. AUTH PATTERN — reuse the exact header shape already used by the private ghJson() helper in packages/lane-portfolio/src/github.ts (Accept: application/vnd.github+json, Authorization: Bearer <token>, User-Agent, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28); if that helper is not exported, duplicate the same four headers exactly rather than inventing a different auth style. Owner/repo parsing: reuse or mirror parseOwnerRepo from that same file (splits 'owner/repo' on '/'). Wiring: T-0054 may already have added credentialsDb + secretsKey to OrbitaMcpDeps and threaded them through apps/orbita-api/src/index.ts — check first and reuse that wiring rather than duplicating it; if T-0054 has not landed yet, add it the same way T-0054's description specifies. HARD CONSTRAINTS: strictly READ-ONLY toward GitHub — these three tools must never call the GitHub API with POST, PATCH, PUT, or DELETE, under any circumstance; that boundary is the entire reason this epic did not need a founder pilot-project restriction the way E-11 did. MCP-tool surface only, no new public HTTP route. Never let the resolved token value appear in a log line, error message, tool response text, or committed file. NOT IN SCOPE for this task (explicitly deferred per E-12 notes): any mutating GitHub call (merge, comment, create/delete file or branch) — stays chat-session-only via the first-party desktop GitHub connector, this tool is intentionally not a way around that; code search across a repo; any scheduling.

tasks.title: Fix wedged cron harness after failed run (portfolio git collector silent since 2026-09-02)
tasks.description: Epic E-13. tasks.description: Epic E-14 strand 3 (part 3).
